“All you’re doing now… is getting brainwashed.”

Video

@AmbNathanSales makes it clear—Iran never upheld its side of the deal and has been breaking it from the start.

“They’ve been violating the cease-fire from the moment the ink was dry.”

Video

“I fully expect a superseding indictment… naming the executives.”

Video

@RepChipRoy: Democrats are acting like it’s war—and Republicans better recognize it.

“You can’t win a war that you don’t acknowledge exists.”

Video

Now the fallout:

“The F now stands for frauds… and felons.”

Video

Laura presses on the status of investigations into Brennan, Comey, Clapper—and accountability for Crossfire Hurricane and the Russia investigation.

@DAGToddBlanche responds:

“These investigations have to be done in secret… or it destroys the integrity.”
